name: AI Race adapter
summary: Speaks the race protocol (ASRP/1) so the AI Race verifier can test your app. You write the AI logic for each task type.

env.note: From your team page on Agent Studio. Only the race verifier sends it.
Name shown in the health response.

prerequisites: A team on Agent Studio (for the verifier token)
A public https:// URL when you race (deploy, or a tunnel such as ngrok)
